recommended_nav_pattern: persistent left sidebar with top utility bar
notes: B2B users value speed and consistency over novelty; optimize for scanability and repeat-use efficiency, not first impressions.

recommended_nav_pattern: sticky top nav with single primary CTA
notes: Optimize for visual impact and CTA clarity above the fold; trust signals (logos, testimonials, metrics) near conversion points.

recommended_nav_pattern: left sidebar with breadcrumb-driven drill-down
notes: Internal tools are used by trained staff daily — favor keyboard efficiency and information density over onboarding-friendliness.

recommended_nav_pattern: command palette + collapsible side panels
notes: Dark-mode-first is close to a hard requirement for this audience; respect existing platform/editor conventions the user already knows.

recommended_nav_pattern: bottom tab bar (mobile) or persistent left rail (desktop)
notes: Optimize for fast content scanning and low-friction posting/reacting; avoid modal-heavy flows that break feed momentum.

recommended_nav_pattern: large icon-based tab bar, minimal text-dependent navigation
notes: Touch targets should exceed the standard 44px minimum; avoid text-heavy navigation for pre-literate age ranges.

recommended_nav_pattern: persistent left sidebar, tabbed sub-views per instrument/account
notes: Numeric precision and consistent decimal alignment matter more than visual flourish; color must map strictly to semantic gain/loss.

recommended_nav_pattern: bottom tab bar (mobile-first), clear balance-first home screen
notes: Trust and clarity outrank cleverness; every screen touching money needs unambiguous confirmation states.

recommended_nav_pattern: linear task-based flow with clear step indicators
notes: Accessibility is non-negotiable (older/impaired users are a primary audience); avoid ambiguous iconography for medical actions.

recommended_nav_pattern: linear multi-step wizard for transactions, flat top nav for informational pages
notes: WCAG AA minimum is a hard requirement, not a nice-to-have; plain-language content over polished marketing tone.

recommended_nav_pattern: top nav with mega-menu categories, persistent cart affordance
notes: Product photography and whitespace do the persuading; checkout flow should minimize steps and field count above all else.

recommended_nav_pattern: minimal floating nav, full-bleed content-first scroll
notes: Distinctiveness and restraint elsewhere define this category — the work is the interface; UI chrome should nearly disappear.

recommended_nav_pattern: left tree navigation with persistent search and right-side in-page outline
notes: Prioritize structure, hierarchy, and a comfortable reading measure over visual novelty; search must be fast and prominent.

recommended_nav_pattern: top nav with category filters, infinite scroll or paginated archive
notes: Typography carries this product — invest disproportionately in the reading type scale and measure over any other visual system.

recommended_nav_pattern: bottom tab bar with prominent live/status indicators
notes: Audience tolerates and rewards bold, high-energy visuals; still keep core stats scanable at a glance during active play.

recommended_nav_pattern: bottom tab bar, single clear daily-action focal point on home
notes: Calm pacing matters as much as visuals — avoid urgency-driven patterns (streak-shaming, aggressive red badges) that undercut the wellness premise.

recommended_nav_pattern: persistent chat input with collapsible conversation history sidebar
notes: Streaming/latency states are core UX, not edge cases — design the 'thinking' and partial-response states as first-class, not afterthoughts.

recommended_nav_pattern: left sidebar for saved views, top filter bar persistent across charts
notes: Chart legibility and consistent color-to-series mapping across the whole tool matter more than any single chart's polish.

recommended_nav_pattern: top nav with search-first hero, sticky booking summary on scroll
notes: High-quality imagery and a frictionless date/guest picker are the two highest-leverage elements; everything else is secondary.

recommended_nav_pattern: top nav with a single persistent donate/act CTA
notes: Emotional storytelling paired with a low-friction, trustworthy donation flow; avoid stock-photo cliché imagery.

recommended_nav_pattern: canvas-centric layout with collapsible tool panels on both edges
notes: The canvas/work surface is the product; chrome should be dense but never compete with it for visual attention.
